text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Listen to this, Boss. When I went home for just one day,
it turned out to be my father's day off too!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy that I ended up talking your ear off.
Though, it was pretty much just me doing all the talking.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
He's a quiet, thoughtful man who is a wonderful listener.
Mother says his subordinates look up to him as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Just like a veteran detective in a drama!
My father truly is cool, yes, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno spent quality time with her family,
making it the best day off ever!
